001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.pathHandler.FixedStaXPathHandler;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.OutputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
009import java.io.StringWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.logging.Logger;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
020import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
021
022/**
023 * XML Filter Command Class
024 *
025 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from XML using XPath expressions. Unlike
026 * XmlNavigateCommand which applies transformations, XmlFilterCommand only extracts/filters elements
027 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
028 *
029 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using XPath expressions - Preserve exact XML structure
030 * of extracted elements - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for complex path
031 * expressions including nested elements and attributes
032 */
033public class XmlFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
034  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlFilterCommand.class.getName());
035
036  private final String xpath;
037  private final FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler;
038
039  /**
040   * Constructor for XML filtering with XPath selector.
041   *
042   * @param xpath the XPath expression to extract elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
043   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null or empty
044   */
045  public XmlFilterCommand(String xpath) {
046    if (xpath == null || xpath.trim().isEmpty()) {
047      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be null or empty");
048    }
049    this.xpath = xpath.trim();
050    this.pathHandler = new FixedStaXPathHandler(xpath);
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  protected String getCommandDetails() {
055    return String.format("XmlFilterCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath);
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
060      throws IOException {
061    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
062
063      XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
064      inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES, false);
065      inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
066
067      List<String> extractedElements = new ArrayList<>();
068
069      XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
070      List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
071      boolean isCapturing = false;
072      int captureDepth = 0;
073      int currentDepth = 0;
074
075      XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
076      StringWriter elementWriter = new StringWriter();
077
078      while (reader.hasNext()) {
079        XMLEvent event = reader.nextEvent();
080
081        if (event.isStartElement()) {
082          currentDepth++;
083          String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
084          currentPath.add(elementName);
085
086          // Check if this element matches our target path
087          if (pathHandler.isTarget(currentPath) && !isCapturing) {
088            isCapturing = true;
089            captureDepth = currentDepth;
090            elementWriter = new StringWriter();
091
092            try {
093              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
094              eventWriter.add(event);
095              eventWriter.close();
096            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
097              LOGGER.warning("Error writing start element: " + e.getMessage());
098            }
099          } else if (isCapturing && currentDepth > captureDepth) {
100            // We're inside a matching element, continue capturing
101            try {
102              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
103              eventWriter.add(event);
104              eventWriter.close();
105            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
106              LOGGER.warning("Error writing nested start element: " + e.getMessage());
107            }
108          }
109
110        } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
111          if (isCapturing) {
112            try {
113              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
114              eventWriter.add(event);
115              eventWriter.close();
116            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
117              LOGGER.warning("Error writing end element: " + e.getMessage());
118            }
119
120            // If we're closing the captured element
121            if (currentDepth == captureDepth) {
122              extractedElements.add(elementWriter.toString());
123              isCapturing = false;
124              captureDepth = 0;
125            }
126          }
127
128          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
129          currentDepth--;
130
131        } else if (isCapturing) {
132          // Characters, comments, etc. inside captured element
133          try {
134            XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
135            eventWriter.add(event);
136            eventWriter.close();
137          } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
138            LOGGER.warning("Error writing content: " + e.getMessage());
139          }
140        }
141      }
142
143      // Write extracted elements to output
144      writeExtractedElements(writer, extractedElements);
145
146      reader.close();
147    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
148      throw new IOException("Error processing XML: " + e.getMessage(), e);
149    }
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Write extracted XML elements to the output writer
154   *
155   * @param writer the output writer
156   * @param elements list of extracted XML elements
157   * @throws IOException if writing fails
158   */
159  private void writeExtractedElements(Writer writer, List<String> elements) throws IOException {
160    if (elements.isEmpty()) {
161      // No matching elements found - output empty XML fragment
162      writer.write("");
163      writer.flush();
164      return;
165    }
166
167    if (elements.size() == 1) {
168      // Single element - write directly
169      writer.write(elements.get(0));
170    } else {
171      // Multiple elements - wrap in a root element
172      writer.write("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>");
173      writer.write("<filtered-results>");
174      for (String element : elements) {
175        writer.write(element);
176      }
177      writer.write("</filtered-results>");
178    }
179
180    writer.flush();
181  }
182}
